params.label: Image
params.tip: Which image version to segment ridges on

params.label: Output name
params.tip: Name for the resulting label set

params.label: Fibre channel
params.tip: One channel to detect ridges in (SHG for collagen, THG for other label-free structure)

params.label: Filter

options.label: Meijering
options.help: Neuriteness filter — clean background, best for elongated structures. Default.

options.label: Sato
options.help: Tubeness — very close to Meijering; slightly more background haze.

options.label: Frangi
options.help: Vesselness — high-precision, low-recall. Only the strongest ridges; misses side branches.

params.tip: Meijering keeps the cleanest background; Frangi picks only the strongest ridges

params.label: Sigma min (px)
params.tip: Smallest fibre width to detect, in pixels

params.label: Sigma max (px)
params.tip: Largest fibre width to detect, in pixels

params.label: Dark ridges
params.tip: Off for bright fibres on dark background (fluorescence, SHG, THG)

params.label: Per z-plane
params.tip: Off collapses Z to a max projection before ridge detection

params.label: Min size (px)
params.tip: Drop connected components smaller than this in pixels; 0 keeps everything
